kb_meta.design_intent: Separate hot-path and warm-path safety knowledge so consuming projects can adopt lightweight enforcement without loading a single monolithic threat base.
notes: The bundle is designed for a framework-only SDK that mediates browsing observations and actions but does not browse by itself.
Each pack can be versioned independently and loaded lazily according to enabled modules.

knowledge_bases.name: Prompt injection patterns
knowledge_bases.purpose: Content-level and social-engineering prompt injection patterns for observation sanitization and prompt attack triage.

knowledge_bases.name: Action integrity patterns
knowledge_bases.purpose: Action drift and misalignment patterns for deterministic gating and metadata-only critics.

knowledge_bases.name: Artifact and non-standard surface patterns
knowledge_bases.purpose: Document viewers, PDFs, OCR, hidden layers, and other web artifact patterns for safe handoff.

knowledge_bases.name: Tool, protocol, and supply-chain patterns
knowledge_bases.purpose: Tool manifest, MCP/OAuth, SSRF, and supply-chain threat patterns.

knowledge_bases.name: Memory and context poisoning patterns
knowledge_bases.purpose: Persistent memory poisoning, summary corruption, and retrieval contamination patterns.

knowledge_bases.name: Trust signals and provenance catalog
knowledge_bases.purpose: Normalized provenance and trust fields that every observation, artifact, and action should carry.

knowledge_bases.name: Policy controls catalog
knowledge_bases.purpose: Canonical control definitions and deployment recommendations.

knowledge_bases.name: Incident response playbooks
knowledge_bases.purpose: Default containment, rollback, quarantine, and forensic response actions.

knowledge_bases.name: Evaluation and red-team scenarios
knowledge_bases.purpose: Benchmark-aligned scenarios, metrics, and harness recommendations.

knowledge_bases.name: Source registry
knowledge_bases.purpose: Traceable research sources and credibility metadata for the KB packs.
